title: Case 20264: Duranta plant sample photos, "Abnormal photo" (redacted) vs "Normal photo"
description: Two-panel photo comparison of plant samples: the left panel, labeled "Abnormal photo," is blanked out by a 1843(a)(2) redaction, while the right panel, labeled "Normal photo," shows a flowering stem with purple blossoms, green leaves and clusters of orange-yellow berries beside a bush full of berries. Text above states the plants appeared stressed by an unknown heat source near where a craft hovered, that the berry ends had an ash-like appearance, and that photos were taken with a Nikon 35mm camera on Kodak ASA 400 film. Text below, under "Evaluation of Evidence," identifies the plant as a Duranta from Tomball, Harris County, Texas.
